description: Generic subscribe/follow reminder (no platform logos): a pill button pops in, a cursor glides over and clicks it (ripple, label flips to the 'done' state with a check), then taps the bell, which rings. Transparent background.

params.text: Button label before the click, default 'Subscribe'
params.doneText: Button label after the click, default 'Subscribed'
params.subtext: Small line under the button, e.g. 'New videos every week' (optional)
params.bell: 'true' (default) to show and ring the notification bell
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10
